label: Cora gets her three names back
to: The Digital Sculptor · The Quiet Tease · The Muse-Drunk Wife
note:
Promoted from stub to a FULL RECORD, replacing the femme-fatale import wholesale. Muse (Digital Sculptor) / Archivist (Loving Curator). Junoesque × Seductress, Devotee × Bubble, spirit animal a MONKEY — clever-handed and always hiding something meaningful inside the machinery.

AND THE SEED OF THE FALSE PROFILE IS NOW ON THE RECORD. Her key arcs include THE LINE IN BLOOD: one vicious defence of Maddy, marked in her own profile as an exception and never her identity. Somebody read that single event backwards into a Velvet Viper, a Femme Fatale and a Bodyguard Bruja. The old profile was not invented out of nothing — it was one true night written up as a whole woman.
